Package com.csse3200.game.components.combat

Class BattleController

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.combat.BattleController
public class BattleController extends Object
The central controller of the current state of the battle loop. Controls what phase the battle is currently in, what actions are currently allowed and what the illegal and legal transitions are This is functionally the Finite State Machine.

    • addBattleLogListener

      public void addBattleLogListener(EventListener1<String> listener)
      Adds a listener for short, human-readable descriptions of what just happened in the battle. Used by the UI to pop up "you did X" / "the enemy did Y" messages between turns.
      Parameters:
      listener - receives the message text

    • addBattleEndListener

      public void addBattleEndListener(EventListener1<Boolean> listener)
      Adds a listener for the end of the battle. The argument is true on a win (all enemies defeated) and false on a loss (player defeated). This is the hook the UI uses to switch to the victory or defeat screen.
      Parameters:
      listener - receives the win/loss flag

    • addEnemyEffectsListener

      public void addEnemyEffectsListener(EventListener1<List<ResolvedCardEffect>> listener)
      Adds a listener that receives the resolved enemy-facing effects of a played card, for Team 1 to apply. The controller also applies these itself so the encounter still resolves.
      Parameters:
      listener - receives the resolved effects

    • addPlayerEffectsListener

      public void addPlayerEffectsListener(EventListener1<List<ResolvedCardEffect>> listener)
      Adds a listener that receives the resolved player-facing effects of a played card, for Team 7 to apply. The controller also applies these itself so the encounter still resolves.
      Parameters:
      listener - receives the resolved effects

    • addHandChangedListener

      public void addHandChangedListener(EventListener1<List<String>> listener)
      Adds a listener that receives the player's hand (card IDs) after it changes, e.g. once a played card has moved from hand to discard. The UI uses this to refresh the on-screen hand.
      Parameters:
      listener - receives the updated hand
